definitions.explanation: A product made in limited quantities or available only for a limited time or at a specific location. Common in Japanese retail culture, where seasonal and regional limited editions are extremely popular.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧{限定品|げんていひん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦すぐ→すぐ：00814_sugu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{売|う}り{切|き}れた→売り切れる：03012_urikireru⟧。
examples.english: This limited edition item sold out immediately.

examples.japanese: ⟦{京都|きょうと}→京都：09484_kyouto⟧⟦{限定|げんてい}→限定：10997_gentei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{限定品|げんていひん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦お{土産|みやげ}→お土産：01353_omiyage⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{買|か}った→買う：00489_kau⟧。
examples.english: I bought a Kyoto-exclusive product as a souvenir.

examples.japanese: ⟦{季節|きせつ}→季節：01304_kisetsu⟧{限定品|げんていひん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{桜|さくら}→桜：02212_sakura⟧⟦{味|あじ}→味：00826_aji⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦チョコレート→チョコレート：05183_chokoreeto⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{毎年|まいとし}→毎年：00731_maitoshi⟧⟦{人気|にんき}→人気：01488_ninki⟧だ。
examples.english: The seasonal limited edition cherry blossom flavored chocolate is popular every year.

notes:
USAGE:
{限定品|げんていひん} is extremely common in Japanese consumer culture. Products are frequently marketed with modifiers like ⟦{期間|きかん}{限定|げんてい}→期間限定：09744_kikangentei⟧ (limited time), ⟦{季節|きせつ}{限定|げんてい}→季節限定：09823_kisetsugentei⟧ (seasonal), ⟦{地域|ちいき}→地域：01461_chiiki⟧⟦{限定|げんてい}→限定：10997_gentei⟧ (regional), or ⟦{数量|すうりょう}{限定|げんてい}→数量限定：09822_suuryougentei⟧ (limited quantity). These limited editions drive consumer interest and urgency.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{期間|きかん}→期間：00229_kikan⟧{限定品|げんていひん} (limited-time product)
- ⟦{季節|きせつ}→季節：01304_kisetsu⟧{限定品|げんていひん} (seasonal limited edition)
- ⟦{地域|ちいき}→地域：01461_chiiki⟧{限定品|げんていひん} (regional exclusive)
- ⟦{数量|すうりょう}→数量：05473_suuryou⟧{限定品|げんていひん} (limited quantity product)
